population.loan_exclusion_rule: exclude only the member or sense chain with a named, sourced borrowing route; an automatic hint alone does not exclude, and original members of a mixed family remain eligible
population.proper_name_rule: exclude proper-name members from the primary analysis and retain them in a separate audit inventory; do not exclude lexical members merely because their structural family also contains a name

human_judgment.semantic_match_rule: a positive match requires an old branch meaning and Arabic meanings from at least two independent old dictionaries to meet directly or through one explicitly named orbital step; both recovery and skeptical lenses must pass, with rejected homonyms and meanings recorded
human_judgment.member_veto_policy: the member or named sense chain is the verdict unit; no verdict inherits across homonyms, compounds, derived members, or other family members

observed_metric.numerator: original reviewed families with at least one confirmed member or sense-chain match carried by an internal lexical bridge; external typological parallels, cross-language loans, proper names, compounds inheriting only from a head, and structural-family co-membership are excluded from the primary numerator

bridge_eligibility.primary_include: internal lexical bridges only: an inherited branch lexeme or sense chain compared directly with an Arabic lexical member under the signed sound network and the signed member-level verdict law
primary_exclude: structural-family co-membership without a lexical relation
typological or sound-symbolic parallels without a licensed lexical bridge
bridge_eligibility.secondary_audit: excluded bridge types remain in a separate descriptive audit and never enter the primary numerator

family_radiation_asymmetry.unit: each confirmed member or sense-chain pair
family_radiation_asymmetry.definition: for each confirmed pair, count eligible same-family lexical continuations supported on the branch side and on the Arabic side after member vetoes; record the signed difference and the log ratio with a one-half continuity correction
family_radiation_asymmetry.primary_role: diagnostic safeguard only; it does not add pairs to the primary numerator and is not a second primary test
family_radiation_asymmetry.purpose: detect whether a positive rate is being driven by broad Arabic fan radiation or by one-sided family expansion rather than a balanced lexical bridge

chance_model.algorithm: within each language and temporal stratum, derange foreign phonological bundles across semantic-family bundles with no fixed points; stratify by consonant length, repeated-consonant pattern, family-size bin, part-of-speech profile, and eligibility flags; regenerate candidates under the frozen network and blind the two human lenses to observed versus perturbed origin
chance_model.blind_semantic_fan_rule: for every observed or perturbed control item, generate the Arabic two-dictionary fan before revealing whether the item is observed or perturbed; present identical source fields, ordering, truncation, and candidate counts to both human lenses; prohibit reuse of a fan annotated with observed/control identity or with a prior verdict

comparison.primary_effect: observed family rate minus perturbed-family chance rate
comparison.uncertainty_method: 95% percentile interval from 10000 stratified family-cluster bootstrap resamples, plus the corrected one-sided permutation p-value (1 + null effects at least as large as observed) / (iterations + 1)
comparison.multiple_comparison_rule: the pooled Semitic effect is the sole primary test; language-by-relation-degree analyses are secondary and use Holm correction

execution_trigger.rule: single confirmatory run, executed once and only once, on the day the eligible denominator first meets the thresholds below; no interim, exploratory, or repeated runs are permitted before or after; the result is committed the day it is produced, positive or negative
execution_trigger.counting_source: families of the two population languages whose members all carry a recorded final disposition, counted by scripts/count_proof_eligible_families.py over the reading files themselves and mirrored into data/family-review-states.json; a family counts only when every member carries an issued verdict or a recorded closure, and both links and closures count, so a language cannot reach the threshold by judging only its positives
execution_trigger.parked_negative_rule: a family whose members sit in SOURCE-GAP, TOOL-GAP, MORPHOLOGY-GAP, LAW-GAP or OPEN-CANDIDATE is not eligible; parking a negative is not judging it

supersedes.reason: Version 1 was signed and armed, but its run trigger counted eligible families from data/family-review-states.json, which was only ever populated with Phoenician and Punic entries, all suspended. The eligible count stood at zero and could not rise from the work being done, so the confirmatory run could never fire. Repairing that wiring after the exploratory results were known would have amended a signed preregistration with knowledge of its own outcome. The author chose re-preregistration instead, on 2026-07-27.

disclosure_at_re_preregistration.principle: Re-preregistration is only honest if it declares everything already known. Every figure below was produced before this document was written and none of it is confirmatory evidence; it is the exploratory state that this test exists to confirm or refute.

excluded_and_why.hebrew: 90.9 percent rests on nine closures against ninety links while 248 of its suspended cards sit in SOURCE-GAP, so its negatives are parked rather than judged and its rate is a selection artifact
excluded_and_why.akkadian: sixty eight links and no closures issued at all; an early-stage file with no denominator

known_defects_repaired_before_this_docum: the recovery scanner re-suspended any card whose audit trail merely mentioned a past blocker
the Coptic loan detector counted U+03E2 to U+03EF as Greek, though Unicode names them Coptic letters inherited from Egyptian Demotic
129 cards carried their obstacle in prose with no structured blocker line
known_open_risks: Hebrew is half the primary population and its negatives are not yet judged; the trigger cannot fire until they are
the exploratory yield gradient may not replicate on a fresh random control sample, which is precisely what this test decides

preregistered_predictions.primary: the observed positive rate on the eligible denominator exceeds the chance line produced by the frozen perturbation model, under the comparison rule already fixed in this document; this is unchanged from version 1

secondary_directional.statement: on the confirmatory sample, the positive rate for close Semitic sisters exceeds the rate for distant Afro-Asiatic cousins, which in turn exceeds the rate for Indo-European branches
secondary_directional.status_before_this_document: observed exploratorily on 2026-07-27 at 58.1, 33.8 and 18.2 percent; it is recorded here as a prediction to be tested, not as a result
secondary_directional.why_it_is_added: it makes the test harder rather than easier: a rate above chance with the ordering violated would be reported as a partial failure, and an instrument that scores a different family as highly as a sister branch is indicting itself rather than supporting the thesis
secondary_directional.failure_condition: if the ordering is violated in the confirmatory sample, the secondary prediction is recorded as failed on the day it is produced, regardless of the primary outcome, and no post-hoc regrouping of languages is permitted

integrity_clauses.no_threshold_may_be_lowered: the totals, the per-language minimum, the comparison rule, the chance model, the seed, the iteration count and the success criterion are fixed by this signature and may not be altered without a new dated signature and a new version
integrity_clauses.negative_result_published_identically: a negative result is written up, committed and published in the same form and with the same prominence as a positive one
